capabilities: Two-way sync the vault with a chosen cloud folder
Resolve sync conflicts by keeping both newer and conflicting versions
Upload a note's images and files to the cloud and rewrite embeds to public links
Show sync progress and last-sync time in the status bar
Run sync on an interval, on save, or manually
extras: The directory listing carries the warning "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." Syncing requires a paid CloudBridge API add-on. Deletions are not propagated by default; true mirroring needs the "Propagate deletions" setting. The README is provided in English and Russian.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is a paid single service, and there is no built-in way to keep a vault mirrored to a cloud storage provider of the user's own choice.

relations.evidence: File operations go through the CloudBridge network drive (/dav/) — the same WebDAV endpoint

summary: Vault sync plugin that mirrors an Obsidian vault two-way to 20+ cloud storages (Yandex Disk, Google Drive, Dropbox, Telegram, MEGA) through a CloudBridge account.
